create.name: Jo Ann Levitt
create.bio:
Jo Ann Levitt, also known by her ashram name Atma, is a spiritual counsellor, channel and author who has worked for many years at Canyon Ranch in the Berkshires as a metaphysician and Healing Touch practitioner. Raised in Reform Judaism, she spent eighteen years living in an ashram steeped in Hindu tradition and yoga, and more than twenty years as a senior faculty member and resident at Kripalu, where she designed many of the centre's early spiritual programmes and compiled a biography of Swami Kripalu. Before that she taught high-school history and worked as a nurse, and she has trained in Kripalu yoga and meditation, Peruvian shamanism, Vivation and Gestalt work.

Her present teaching centres on helping people reach their own connection with Source. She describes herself as a scribe who receives material from her guides, and her books include Channeling the Sacred, Awakening to the Power of Source, on co-creating with spirit, and The Spiritual Path of Aging, which treats later life as a time for deeper practice and is the basis of her workshops on the subject at Omega and elsewhere. She offers private Zoom sessions of spiritual guidance, Healing Touch and tarot, and teaches step by step how to work with spirit guides on her podcast, The Awakening Channel.

books.title: The Spiritual Path of Aging
books.author: Jo Ann Levitt
books.description: A guide for elders who want to meet the changes of later life as a spiritual path. It encourages readers to find a form of practice that suits them and to make regular time for it.

books.title: Awakening to the Power of Source: Your Guide to Co-Creating with the Divine
books.author: Jo Ann Levitt
books.description: A practical book on inviting spiritual guidance into creative work of any kind, from writing to business. It builds on her channelling practice and earlier book Channeling the Sacred.

courses.title: Private Zoom Sessions: Spiritual Guidance, Healing Touch and Tarot
courses.description: Fifty-minute sessions on Zoom, for individuals or couples. Guidance sessions use meditation, dialogue and channelled messages from spiritual guides; Healing Touch sessions are given while you rest at home with a guided visualisation; tarot readings address a question you bring.

free_resources.title: The Awakening Channel (podcast)
free_resources.description: Her podcast teaches channelling step by step, arguing that contact with spirit guides is a natural capacity open to anyone. Episodes cover different methods of reaching and interpreting guidance.
